module: Shared constant tables of the UI router: transition states, navigation action types, guard results, framework actions, UI types filter, default values of the info bar / top bar / UI apps, default route configuration, and names of the emitted hooks (GUI events "ui_router_<name>" and extension hooks "on<Event>"). Pure data module.
notes: RouterHooks gives the suffixes of the GUI events (ui_router_routeChange, ui_router_afterRouteChange, ui_router_routeChangeCancelled...). RouterExtensionHooks gives the names of the Lua hooks called by extensions.hook: onAfterRouteChange and onRouteTiming (duration of a navigation, see router.lua).

UiTypesFilter describes which frameworks must finish for a route change to succeed: only (only the listed types), except (all except those listed), all (all registered types), any (at least one of the listed types). The router considers a route "handoff" if the filter is only and uiTypes contains "vue".
RouteConfigDefaults.ui = {uiTypes = {"angular", "vue"}, uiTypesFilter = any, infoBar, uiApps, topBar}.

Several values (for example GuardResult, FrameworkAction, NavigationAction, or the hooks ROUTE_CHANGE_SUCCESS and TRANSITION_TIMEOUT) are not used in router.lua; they serve as a shared vocabulary with the other modules.

TransitionStatus.desc: States of the router's state machine: IDLE="idle", TRANSITIONING="transitioning", CANCELLED="cancelled".

NavigationAction.desc: Navigation action types: PUSH, REPLACE, BACK, FORWARD.

GuardResult.desc: Guard result types: ALLOW="allow", REJECT="reject", REDIRECT="redirect".

FrameworkAction.desc: What a framework must do for a route: RENDER, BLANK, HIDE, PASSTHROUGH.

UiTypesFilter.desc: Filter of the frameworks that must finish: only, except, all, any.

RouteConfigDefaults.desc: Default route configuration: {ui = {uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, uiApps, topBar}}.

RouterHooks.desc: Hook names: beforeRouteChange, routeChange, routeChangeSuccess, afterRouteChange, routeChangeError, routeChangeCancelled, transitionTimeout, navigationStateResponse.
